title: Laredo Actor Rogelio Ramos Confirms He Is a Voice in GTA VI
excerpt: Laredo-born actor Rogelio Ramos confirmed on Instagram that he appears in Grand Theft Auto VI — a role a nondisclosure agreement kept him from talking about until launch.
content:
Laredo has a voice in Vice City. Laredo-born actor Rogelio Ramos confirmed on Instagram on Friday, November 20, that he appears in Grand Theft Auto VI, one day after Rockstar Games released the game for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Ramos said a nondisclosure agreement kept him from talking about the role before launch. Now that the game is out, he can say it: he is in it.

Rockstar lists Ramos in the game's credits under "The Local Population," but the credits do not name the character he plays. Which voice is his, players will have to figure out for themselves.

Ramos began his entertainment career at 16, worked for Telemundo, and later moved from Laredo to Los Angeles to pursue acting. His credits also include Spider-Man 3 and Silicon Valley. He had hinted at the GTA VI role in an interview earlier this year, before the game's release.

GTA VI launched on Thursday, November 19, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar has not announced a PC release date.
